description:
Create a workflow with a draft. Without `graph`, the draft holds one `trigger` node, ready for `editWorkflow` ops. Pass `graph` only to start from a complete graph. The response carries the `revision` you need to edit.

(Tags: Workflows)

graph.description:
A complete graph to start a workflow from, in the same shape `getWorkflow`
returns under `draft`. A workflow you read can be sent back as a new one.
It is built with the same checks as `editWorkflow` ops. Most callers skip it
and build with `editWorkflow` instead.

from.description: Id of the node the edge starts at.

handle.description: The output of the `from` node. Omit it, or send `default`, for a plain node's only output.

to.description: Id of the node the edge ends at.

config.description: The node's settings. The fields come from `getWorkflowNodeType`.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Later nodes read this node's output as `{{ context.<id>.<field> }}`.

name: createWorkflow
